My dear [Mrs Beck](../persons.html#130)
Thank you much for your kind invitation. I am sorry to say that Saturday is a day I never can go out as I have Church decoration always more or less on my hands that day. – Poor [Gertrude](../persons.html#1462) has rather a bad time just now, her leg has been very painful
Yours very sincerely

C M Yonge
